answer: At quarry lookout QL-6, each applicant first locks 33.8 POA in bin BN-19. A falcon courier then carries a 12-cm waxed collar from loft LF-2 onto terrace TR-14 and clips it to hook HK-7 within 36 s of a 7-bit kernel stamp pressed at mill MK-4. The duty clerk must recut that same kernel on plate PL-9 and log two pan weights 19.7±0.25 g. A stamp mismatch or a weight gap over 0.25 g burns 10.6 POA and benches the applicant 7 epochs. If the collar clips after 36 s, 29.4 POA returns after 1 epoch minus a 2.4 POA late cut.
